contractNote: modules[].contract declares each module's inputs/outputs/invariants/probes (the blueprint node contract). dependsOn is the declared edge set; --probe-blueprint scans real cross-module references and fails on undeclared edges, regenerating docs/BLUEPRINT.md. Update contract and dependsOn in the same commit as the code change.
purpose: Machine-readable navigation map for Franca developers and coding agents.
northStar: Safe, understandable, recoverable game-language access for supported games.

navigation.usage: Match one feature, read its entryPoints, then expand to relatedPaths and callers only as needed. Paths are repository-relative; wildcards are globs.

features.sideEffects: Probes use temporary synthetic fixtures and injected providers only, no network/game writes. Optional pak probe artifactDirectory retains a synthetic archive for independent UnrealPak checking. --ue-inspect <pak> [targetCulture] reads real archives only. --ue-prepare <gameDir> <source.pak> <appId> <outputDir> <settings.json> <packsDir> <seconds> [--language=ja] [--slot=zh-Hans] <sourcePath>... reads an explicit source pak and contacts only enabled GoogleTranslateV2 (translate.googleapis.com) and BingTranslate (www.bing.com/cn.bing.com) through AppTranslator; writes packs and uncompressed prepared generations outside the game only. --ue-prepare-cached takes the same arguments but disables all providers and never contacts the network. English source, zh-CN default or ja translation with separate language caches; explicit existing target slot defaults to zh-Hans and is recorded in manifest. Preserve target-only native entries and report their count. --ue-table-inspect reads supported GameText/Database/*EN.uasset pairs. --ue-table-prepare and --ue-table-prepare-cached use the same arguments/options as locres preparation, translate supported cooked FText tables and preserve source-empty target rows. Unknown schemas are rejected; table probes use synthetic data only. No formal UI installation/launch; manually authorized live testing is recorded separately.

Creates or updates the local root launch shortcut with absolute executable/icon paths; does not start Franca. A successful standard Windows Release build refreshes the shortcut automatically; custom output directories and design-time builds do not. The setup script can also regenerate it manually after relocating the checkout. Static documentation checks only require JSON, links and paths. Packaged notices retain their existing runtime filenames.

Setting defaults on, persists on click and immediately filters library counts and recent shortcut. Reads local Steam appinfo v39-v41 types; known game/demo/mod evidence overrides fallback names. Unmanifested directories use unambiguous exact install-dir metadata and auxiliary-only EA anti-cheat signatures, then known software name fallbacks. Unknown entries remain visible without such evidence. Does not remove scanned entries, write Steam/game directories or request network metadata. Probe uses transient settings, synthetic binary fixtures, local HTTP fixtures and read-only Steam scanning; shows a non-activating off-screen window with background services disabled to verify the loaded settings control and Click handler, and optionally saves screenshots.
Reads local Steam registry/library; may render screenshots. Inspect probe setup before running.

Names probe reads Steam library, accesses network and name cache; library probe supplies simulated language evidence for target and optional secondary language. Cached titles/evidence are displayed before network work. Manual official-support refresh queries Steam language evidence only, retains prior evidence on failure, and never translates titles. Secondary language only affects official-support display/order, never provider requests or game configuration.

These probes use synthetic directories; real enable/disable/repair writes game files. Installation requires separate real-game acceptance. Installation probe uses temporary fixtures only, with disk/cancellation/validation/conflict injection; real install retains .franca/installations/<id>/manifest.json and overwritten-file backups. Pending transactions recover before readiness checks. Source/target language changes start a shared five-second countdown with pause/resume and apply-now controls. Completion repairs stopped installed Unity games with backups; does not enable disabled games or install runtimes. Running/unknown process states are skipped and reported. Language-apply probe uses temporary fixtures, process inspection, and a loopback relay only.
Probe uses synthetic evidence; real repair can close and restart game/Steam processes. Probe success is not real repair acceptance.

Architecture and endpoint-config probes use transient settings and loopback HTTP only. --probe-deepseek explicitly reads the saved local DeepSeek key and makes two short paid API calls (health + production translation), never logs credentials and does not change the active endpoint. Other translation probes contact live providers and may consume quota. Production protocols live in TranslationProviders.*.cs; EndpointTestService only wraps health checks.

Architecture and dictionary probes use unique temporary packs/dictionaries/game directories and loopback mock providers only. Dictionary probe also covers the Slice-2 game-text sync: PrepareForGame full dump and buffered runtime appends to <game>/BepInEx/Translation/<lang>/Text/Franca.txt (dictionary entries are never written there), cold empty-pack reload ordering and preservation of existing runtime cache text. Sync creates a missing default _AutoGeneratedTranslations.txt before publishing Franca.txt; it never truncates an existing runtime cache. Custom output paths remain managed by XUnity. Legacy --probe-relay contacts live endpoints and deletes/recreates synthetic pack 999999 in the executable directory. Identified requests use /translate/<appid>; legacy /translate skips game-pack caching.

Startup probe checks local resources, all 15 UI languages and six theme palettes (normal text contrast >= 4.5:1); navigation probe constructs real WPF pages with background services disabled, uses synthetic game rows and writes six-theme screenshots of status/settings/endpoints/library. No real endpoint requests or game writes.

Builds native x64 proxy and managed/native fixtures using an existing MSVC/SDK/.NET9 toolchain. Probe uses unique temporary directories and local WinHTTP handles without SendRequest; no game writes or input injection. Native binaries and exports stay under ignored src/Loader/build. Actual Unity bootstrap timing and game translation remain separate acceptance gates.

Probes use temporary fixtures and loopback HTTP only. Real-game config repair backs up INI, accepts up to 2500 characters and retains paragraph whitespace; restart the game to apply. Provider requests are at most 200 characters; UI receives the reconstructed full document.

Reads source files and architecture.json; rewrites docs/BLUEPRINT.md only. No network, no game directories. Module contracts live in modules[].contract in this file; the probe fails on undeclared cross-module references.

Overlay probe shows a real WPF window offscreen without activation, reads native styles and foreground handle, uses temporary packs and loopback mock translation only, writes a rendered PNG. It does not inject input or validate real-game overlay/keyboard/DPI behavior.

criticalFlows: desktop.enable-game -> application.GameTranslationService -> installer.install-or-validate -> per-game relay URL in XUnity config -> runtime.relay -> pack.lookup-or-translation -> pack.store
desktop.repair-game -> application.GameTranslationService -> installer.health-check -> backup -> repair-config -> recheck -> separate real-game-validation
desktop.EndpointAutoController -> translation.EndpointAutoService -> verified selection -> published settings snapshot -> next relay request

runtimeIdentity.legacyPolicy: Translate without reading or writing game packs; never infer identity from ActiveGameAppId.
runtimeIdentity.migration: Existing INI files are preserved. Explicit game configuration repair writes the identified route; no batch game-directory rewrite.
runtimeIdentity.settings: Desktop publishes deep snapshots; each relay request captures one snapshot. The source and target query parameters apply to that request.
